name: Embershield
lines: (5 items) When you complete a fully-charged Heavy Attack, you increase your Physical and Spell Resistance by 3300 and deal 315 Flame damage to all enemies within 5 meters of you every 1 second for 6 seconds. The damage scales off the higher of your Physical or Spell Resistance.

name: Encratis's Behemoth
lines: (2 items) Dealing Flame Damage to an enemy grants you Behemoth's Aura for 12 seconds that reaches up to 12 meters. You and up to 11 group members in the aura reduce Flame Damage taken by 5%. Enemies in the aura increase their Flame Damage taken by 5%. This effect can occur once every 15 seconds.

name: Enervating Aura
lines: (5 items) When you deal direct damage, you have a 10% chance to create an area under the target that detonates after 1 second, applying Enervating Aura and Minor Enervation for 10 seconds to enemies within 5 meters. Enervating Aura lowers the Health Recovery, Magicka Recovery, and Stamina Recovery of enemy players by 129 per player hit. This effect can occur once every 15 seconds.

name: Engine Guardian
lines: (2 items) When you use an ability that costs resources, you have a 25% chance to summon a Dwemer automaton to restore 550 Stamina or Magicka or 1955 Health to you every 0.5 seconds for 6 seconds. This effect can occur once every 10 seconds.

name: Esoteric Environment Greaves
lines: (1 item) While you are above 50% Stamina, reduce your direct damage taken by 50% and lose 968 Stamina whenever you take direct damage, up to once every 0.3 seconds.

name: Essence Thief
lines: (4 items) Adds 129 Weapon and Spell Damage

(5 items) Dealing damage with a Light or Heavy Attack draws essence from the enemy that pools near them for 5 seconds. Drawing from the pool heals you for 4356 Health, restores 4356 Stamina, and increases your damage done by 10% for 10 seconds. A pool can only be created once every 10 seconds.

name: Eternal Hunt
lines: (5 items) When you use Roll Dodge, you leave behind a rune that detonates when an enemy comes close, dealing 993 Poison damage and immobilizing them for 1.5 seconds. This effect scales off the higher of your Weapon or Spell Damage.

name: Eternal Vigor
lines: (5 items) Adds 337 Stamina and Magicka Recovery while your Health is above 50%. Adds 1011 Health Recovery while your Health is 50% or less.
